info.title: Bloom Shop API - Unified Specification
info.description: Complete consolidated OpenAPI specification for Bloom Shop E-Commerce microservices, accessible through Bloom API Gateway.

post.description: Authenticates credentials with Keycloak and returns JWT tokens
Generates a new access token for user
Creates a new customer account with Keycloak

get.description: Retrieves a flat list of all active categories
Retrieves top-level categories with their nested children
Retrieves a single category by its URL slug
Retrieves a paginated list of active products
Retrieves products flagged for homepage featured showcase
Searches active products by name or description keyword
Retrieves full product details using its SEO-friendly URL slug
Returns all items in the authenticated customer's shopping cart

put.description: Updates quantity of a specific cart item (deletes if quantity <= 0)

post.description: Adds a new item to the customer's cart or increments the quantity if the item already exists

delete.description: Removes a specific item from the cart

post.summary: Checkout cart and place an order

get.summary: Get order detail by order number

post.summary: Simulate mock complete for an order

400.description: Order is not paid, or already cancelled or delivered

post.summary: Simulate mock payment for an order
post.description: Marks an order as PAID and transitions status to be SHIPPED

400.description: Order is already paid or cancelled

get.description: Retrieves all variants whose available stock is less than or equal to the specified threshold

200.description: List of low stock inventory records

post.description: Adds stock to an existing variant or creates a new inventory record if none exists

get.description: Retrieves current available and reserved stock for a specific product variant
